text: You've got the money to fix this. What you haven't got is a free Thursday to sit down and work out what this even is. That's not a money problem and it isn't a smarts problem, it's a calendar one. Comment BOTTLENECK and I'll send you the free check that names it.

Every system you've got works. You built them. The problem is they all run through you, and you're the part that's fully booked. Comment BOTTLENECK and I'll send you the free check that finds which one you're holding up.

You don't need another course on doing it yourself. You've got a project and you've got a goal, and what's missing is somebody to run it. That's the whole job. Comment RETAINER and I'll show you what handing it over actually looks like.

I run coverage across 4 departments for a living. Nobody there cares about my morning routine, they care whether the breaks get covered and the truck gets worked. That's the brain I bring to a business. Comment TUESDAY for the letter where I show the work.

Overwhelmed isn't a discipline problem. It's an undersystemed one. You don't need to want it more, you need fewer things running on memory. Comment RESET and I'll send you the one that survives a Wednesday.

Doing it yourself is free right up until you count the hours. Then it's you, plus the person you hired to help, plus the 3 tools you bought because nobody could agree on one. Paying once for somebody to run it is cheaper than all 4. Comment BOTTLENECK.

Here's the part nobody puts in writing: if I can't do it, you don't pay me. That's not confidence, it's just how I'd want to be sold to. Comment BOTTLENECK and I'll send the free check, and you can decide from there whether you want me anywhere near it.

Money's coming in and there's still a low hum of anxiety about it. That isn't ingratitude and it isn't bad math. That's money with no jobs. Comment BUDGET and I'll send you the one I run my own money on.

You know what needs doing. You just don't know what to do first, and that's the actual hard part nobody warns you about. Deciding is the work. The doing is easy once the order exists. Comment DECISION.

I wrote the AI guide 60 days in, not 10 years in, because 60 days in I still remembered what was confusing. If that's what I hand out for nothing, it's worth wondering what happens when you put me on something that matters. Comment GUIDE.
